seo.title: About StarOrigin | Recruitment built on people
seo.description: StarOrigin is a recruitment and staffing partner with offices in Nagpur, Hyderabad, Dubai and Dallas. Practice heads, ethical hiring and technology that supports judgement.

hero.title: Outsource your HR to
hero.lead: StarOrigin is a recruitment and staffing partner built on people: practice heads who know your market, ethics you can rely on and technology that supports judgement instead of replacing it.

items.title: From one office in Nagpur to three countries.
items.text: Headquartered in Nagpur, StarOrigin is built on a simple idea: hiring goes better when a dedicated, experienced person owns it from brief to joining day. That idea shapes how every search is run. Today we operate from Nagpur and Hyderabad in India, Dubai in the UAE and Dallas in the US, placing everyone from first-time specialists to CXOs for clients across industries.

items.title: To make your success our job, with dedicated practice heads, an ethical outlook and a value-added approach to every hire.
items.text: We combine expertise and technology to help clients and candidates unlock their true potential.

heading.title: What we
heading.lead: Six principles that guide how we work with clients, candidates and each other.

items.title: Results first
items.text: Professionalism measured by outcomes: the right person, in the seat, staying.

items.title: Straight talk
items.text: Direct, honest communication about the market, timelines and candidates, even when it isn't what you hoped to hear.

items.title: Fleet-footed follow-through
items.text: We move quickly, close loops and keep every stakeholder updated.

items.title: Trust and loyalty
items.text: Long-term relationships matter more than any single placement.

items.title: Quality throughout
items.text: In the clients we take on, the consultants we hire, the solutions we design and the process we follow.

items.title: Innovation with a personal touch
items.text: New tools where they help, and a real person on the other end of every call.

heading.title: How we
heading.lead: Key moments in StarOrigin's growth. Dates shown are placeholders until confirmed.

items.title: Founded in Nagpur
items.text: StarOrigin Pvt Ltd opens its first office and launches starorigin.in.

items.title: Hyderabad office opens
items.text: A second Indian base at Workafella Western Aqua to serve South India's tech and BFSI clients.

items.title: StarOrigin LLC FZ, Dubai
items.text: A UAE entity in Jumeirah Bay Tower, JLT, for clients across the Middle East.

items.title: StarOrigin Inc, Dallas
items.text: US operations launch with W2, C2C and contract-to-hire staffing.

items.title: 4 offices, 8 services
items.text: A talent network of more than 8,240 candidate profiles across India, the UAE and the US.
